items.title: VLTO Q3 deep dive: water analytics growth and cost optimization drive strong results
items.summary: Water analytics and treatment company Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $1.51 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.18 per share was 8.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
